name: R-2 gated installed Claude Code hook parity
summary: The explicitly enabled installed-copy parity probe passed all five cases: canonical helper equality, detached loading with the negative control, temporary-file hygiene, fixture drift detection, and byte-for-byte parity between every current source hook and the installed runtime copy.

assertions.evidence: The packaged pc_home.mjs bytes equal libs/host-platform/src/home.mjs.
Six affected hooks import successfully from a detached copy with NODE_OPTIONS cleared; removing pc_home.mjs makes the subprocess fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
No atomic-edit temporary files are present in the source hook directory.
The parity fixture detects a missing installed hook, accepts equal bytes, and detects changed installed bytes.
With PAPERCUSP_VERIFY_INSTALLED_CC_HOOKS=1, every current source hook matches its ~/.papercusp/hooks/cc runtime copy byte-for-byte; zero tests were skipped.

limits: This is a local installed-runtime parity witness for the named test file; it does not establish final-release shipment.

The installer provenance stamp still names the prior multi-hook source commit because its provenance summarizes the full hook set; the compared installed bytes were directly re-synchronized to the current committed source before this run.
